correctness.rationale: The labeled-pair transition product for 1100 is the exact zero matrix, proving image exclusion. Enumerating the 32 five-bit inputs to F∘G yields precisely four mismatch patterns, each containing 1100, proving explicit sufficiency on all cyclic lengths. The displayed eight-state weighted automaton has exact determinant 1-(1+u)z+u^2 z^4 by a finite coefficient-level calculation, implying the formal trace generating function and all coefficient formulas. The standalone checker verifies local identities, zero product, determinant and brute images/weight coefficients through n=16; the infinite results follow from the displayed proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The one-step reachable-state set for the classical density-conserving traffic automaton is a natural information-loss and feasible-output invariant. This result solves membership constructively via an explicit local right section, counts all reachable indexed configurations at every ring length and density, and determines output entropy exactly. It has distinct content from known impossibility examples, generic transfer matrices, or a finite low-length tabulation.
